This is the `swear01/hapi` maintained build based on official HAPI `v0.23.4`, plus upstream `main` through [`d90bde0`](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/commit/d90bde0b889bf3a9d461bb8c62f74a5b653cc757).

## Compared with the previous maintained release (`v0.23.4.1`)

Eight newly audited upstream bug-fix PRs are included:

- Group orphaned subagent traces by `parentToolUseId` ([#1175](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/pull/1175)).
- Align the conversation-outline close button ([#1150](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/pull/1150)).
- Preserve loaded message history during streaming ([#1126](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/pull/1126)).
- Open Windows absolute file paths in the session viewer ([#1113](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/pull/1113)).
- Center the active scratchlist icon ([#1105](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/pull/1105)).
- Continue Cursor tasks correctly after CreatePlan approval ([#1097](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/pull/1097)).
- Hide `tool_progress` heartbeat events from chat delivery ([#1094](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/pull/1094)).
- Handle Cursor worktree banners and linked-worktree startup safely ([#1087](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/pull/1087)).

## Upstream PR audit

All 63 open upstream PRs were scanned before this build. The eight focused, clean, green bug fixes above were carried. Feature-sized or product-expanding PRs were deferred to avoid unrequested scope, including configurable grouping, pinned sessions, image navigation/sharing, provider profiles, workspace Git controls, new notification channels, and new session-import surfaces. Draft, dirty, failing, or unstable PRs were deferred. Codex session-import PRs and follow-ups remain dropped by policy; #1147 was not carried because it only repairs the excluded import path. Existing maintained PR patches remain in the queue.

## Compared with the official release (`tiann/hapi v0.23.4`)

This build contains the eight audited fixes above plus the existing maintained patch set for OpenCode recovery, macOS Codex Desktop restart, project-group actions, scratchlist promotion, Codex terminal recovery, Fast/personality/Create controls, mid-turn steering, and sidebar name priority. Codex local-session import remains excluded.

## Maintained-fork guarantees

- Release tags must point to commits contained in `main` and match the four-part CLI version.
- macOS binaries are signed with the stable `xyz.hapi.cli` identity.
- Fork builds do not publish over upstream GitHub Pages or update the upstream Homebrew formula.
- The app shell is served with no-store cache headers.
